sentences.source_note: Corrects repeated placement of the waking time after 起床.

sentences.chinese: 她在家照顾我们的两个女儿。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài jiā zhàogù wǒmen de liǎng ge nǚ'ér.
sentences.english_hint: She takes care of our two daughters at home.
sentences.scenario: Explain what your wife does at home.
sentences.source_note: Uses the analysis's supported family context and corrected place-before-action structure.

sentences.chinese: 上节课我们学了这部分。
sentences.pinyin: Shàng jié kè wǒmen xué le zhè bùfen.
sentences.english_hint: We learned this part last lesson.
sentences.scenario: Tell your teacher what you covered previously.
sentences.source_note: Corrects repeated confusion between 上节课 and 上课 or 下课.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè jié kè wǒ xiǎng jìxù xué.
sentences.english_hint: I want to keep learning this lesson.
sentences.scenario: Ask to continue the material in today's class.
sentences.source_note: The analysis supplies this model for the learner's wish to continue.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de gōngzuò yǒu shíhou máng.
sentences.scenario: Describe how busy your job is.
sentences.source_note: Successful prompted usage replaces 可以忙 for 'sometimes busy.'

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bú shì měi tiān dōu máng.
sentences.scenario: Clarify that your busy days are occasional.
sentences.source_note: Practices the successfully prompted 不是每天都忙 pattern.

sentences.chinese: 照顾两个孩子比上班难。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàogù liǎng ge háizi bǐ shàngbān nán.
sentences.english_hint: Caring for two children is harder than going to work.
sentences.source_note: Corrects the incomplete childcare comparison using the analysis's model.

sentences.chinese: 我的工资比同事的工资低。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de gōngzī bǐ tóngshì de gōngzī dī.
sentences.english_hint: My salary is lower than my colleague's.
sentences.scenario: Compare your pay with a colleague's.
sentences.source_note: Repeated salary comparisons need a complete 比 structure and salary-to-salary comparison.

sentences.chinese: 虽然我对工资有点不满意，但是我不想换工作。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán wǒ duì gōngzī yǒudiǎn bù mǎnyì, dànshì wǒ bù xiǎng huàn gōngzuò.
sentences.english_hint: Although I'm a little unhappy with my pay, I don't want to change jobs.
sentences.scenario: Explain why you are staying despite your pay concerns.
sentences.source_note: Preserves the learner's clarified dissatisfaction with salary and wish to stay; uses the corrected analysis model.

sentences.english_hint: Looking for a job isn't easy now.
sentences.scenario: Explain why you are reluctant to start a job search.
sentences.source_note: The analysis corrects job-search wording to 找 and confirms the difficulty of searching.

sentences.chinese: 如果找到新工作，工资可能会涨。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ zhǎodào xīn gōngzuò, gōngzī kěnéng huì zhǎng.
sentences.english_hint: If you find a new job, your pay may go up.
sentences.scenario: Discuss a possible benefit of finding another job.
sentences.source_note: The analysis supplies this concise version of the learner's successful conditional about a new job and higher pay.

sentences.pinyin: Chá hé kāfēi wǒ dōu xǐhuan hē.
sentences.english_hint: I like drinking both tea and coffee.
sentences.scenario: Answer when someone asks whether you like tea or coffee.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 我喜欢喝都 and preserves the learner's preference for both drinks.

sentences.chinese: 我每天用这个软件复习汉字。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān yòng zhè ge ruǎnjiàn fùxí Hànzì.
sentences.english_hint: I review Chinese characters with this software every day.
sentences.scenario: Show someone your daily character-review tool.
sentences.source_note: Adapts the corrected 用这个APP复习汉字 model with TTS-friendly 软件; daily app review is supported.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ juéde hěn duō Hànzì hěn xiàng.
sentences.english_hint: I think many Chinese characters look similar.
sentences.scenario: Explain why distinguishing characters is difficult.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 跟我一样 to the intended impression that characters resemble one another.
